apps.name: Life Changer
apps.shortDesc: Follow the helicopter and tap UP or DOWN anytime!
apps.description:
Life Changer is a fast helicopter game played with virtual coins.

The helicopter flies up and down on a live chart. Tap UP or DOWN anytime to trade, and close your trade at the right moment!

• Green UP and red DOWN buttons – trade in one tap
• Quick amounts: +10, +50, +100, +500 or MAX
• Crash history and My trades at the top of the screen
• DEMO mode with free practice coins to learn the game
• Night mode, 7 color themes and a background slider
• Vibration on/off and a built-in "How to play" guide

Life Changer uses virtual coins only. Coins have no real-money value and cannot be bought, sold or exchanged for money.
